remarks: There is something to be said for an easy, convenient, low maintenance lifestyle! Feel right at home in this 3-bedroom 2.5 baths New Canaan Townhouse featuring hardwood floors, an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, custom cabinetry and stone flooring. The adjacent dining room walks out to a spacious deck for outdoor dining as well. Enjoy beautiful, natural views of the Five Mile River and relaxation from the private deck. The home includes a walk-out finished lower level including a newer full bathroom and laundry room (potential in-law/au-pair suite space, family room, or extra bedroom). There are two designated off-street parking spaces with supplemental visitor parking. Located close to town, train, shopping, dining, parks, award-winning schools, and all the charm New Canaan has to offer. Come see for yourself! *ASKING FOR HIGHEST & BEST OFFERS BY 9/24/24 6pm
